comment: Face and edge references found again after a sketch change renamed their faces (mitcad#272), through the OCCT kernel. Sketch1: a 60 x 40 outline (c7 bottom, c8 right, c9 top, c10 left) whose corner at (0, 40) is rounded by the arc c11 (radius 5), with circles of radius 5 at the three other corners (c12 at the origin, c13, c14), extruded 10 mm from the region inside the outline and outside the circles (Extrude1 F2, Body1).
Fillet1 (F3) rounds the two vertical edges where the circles meet the lines next to the arc (c9 at c14, c10 at c12).

The arc goes and a circle of diameter 12 (c15) takes its place at the corner: c9 and c10 now end on c15, so their faces are renamed (c9[c14,c15], c10[c15,c12]) and the fillet's stored edges no longer exist under their names. The extrusion's region is found by the most curves in common and warns (mitcad#407).
The fillet finds both edges between the faces it finds, rounds the same edges and warns.
